verify.title: Verify a draw result
verify.desc: Enter a draw ID to independently verify the cryptographic winner selection. No login required.
verify.emptyDesc: Completed draw IDs are published with every campaign result.
verify.notFound: Draw not found or not yet published.
verify.fail: ✗ Verification failed — result could not be reproduced
verify.independentNote: You can reproduce this result independently using the verifier script at docs/draw-protocol/.
verify.step1: 1. Download the verification package (pool hash, seed, canonical message).
verify.step2: 2. Sort the eligible entry IDs and compute SHA-256 of the canonical list.
verify.step3: 3. Confirm the pool hash matches the published commitment.
verify.step4: 4. Compute HMAC-SHA256(seed, canonical_message) and confirm the digest matches.
verify.step5: 5. Map the digest to the winner index using index = int(digest, 16) % total_entries.
